description: Record that an asset left the business on a date and return the gain or loss against net book value. proceeds_minor is in MINOR units. Depreciation stops here, and a second disposal is refused.

asset.description: Asset id such as ASSET-2026-0001, or an exact or partial name

date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD the asset left the business. It cannot be before the in-service date

note.description: What happened, e.g. sold to a dealer, written off after a fire

proceeds_minor.description: Sale proceeds in MINOR units, default 0 for a scrapping or a write-off

name: asset_dispose
title: Dispose of an asset
